note: Ranks PROBLEMS, not features. score = severity * frequency * observability (1-5 each). observability = how well declared-vs-observed evidence can show it without inference.

problems.problem: Declared time-scoped constraints (freezes, gates) are crossed without anyone noticing until the demo

problems.problem: A person joining midway cannot see the plan against reality: next gate, open commitments
problems.existing_coverage: boards plus calendars, both stale in fast projects
